_about: Today's English of Setup and the uninstaller, recorded before #103 moved the script's texts into installer-messages (step a1 of its plan, at c05f45d, by tests/installer_words.py): every box, status line, page heading and line, Finish page sentence, task and run box of installer.iss, with {Name} for a value the code fills in, and the names that stay: the product, the Apps list's name, the publisher, the Start-menu folder and its two shortcuts. tests/test_installer_words.py holds the script to these bytes. Never re-recorded: English must not change.

words.setup.name: Claude Usage Monitor
words.apps.name: Claude Usage Monitor version {AppVer}
words.task.startup: &Start with Windows (start the monitor when I sign in)
words.webview2.offer:
The dashboard window needs the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime, and it is not installed on this PC.

Without it the dashboard opens in your web browser instead. Everything else works the same.

Download Microsoft's installer for it (about 2 MB) and run it after the installation?
words.download.caption: Downloading the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime
words.download.description: Setup is downloading the installer for the runtime that the dashboard window needs.
words.webview2.download_failed:
The WebView2 installer could not be downloaded, so the installation continues without it.

The dashboard will open in your web browser. You can install the WebView2 Runtime later from microsoft.com and it will be used automatically.
words.still_running/Setup:
Claude Usage Monitor is still running. It did not close when Setup asked it to.

Close it from its icon near the clock (right-click it, then Exit), and click Retry.
words.prepare.still_running: Claude Usage Monitor is still running, so Setup stopped without changing anything. Close the monitor, then run Setup again.
words.in_use:
Claude Usage Monitor cannot be updated because {Path} is in use. Nothing was changed.

Close the program and run Setup again.
words.moved_back_failed:
Setup moved {Exe} to {OldExe}, and could not move it back.

Please rename it back by hand and run Setup again.
words.webview2.checking: Checking the Microsoft Edge WebView2 installer...
words.webview2.not_verified:
The WebView2 installer that was downloaded could not be verified as Microsoft's, so it was not run.

Claude Usage Monitor is installed, and its dashboard will open in your web browser. You can install the WebView2 Runtime later from microsoft.com and it will be used automatically.
words.webview2.installing: Installing the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime...
words.webview2.not_installed: The Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime could not be installed. Claude Usage Monitor is installed, and its dashboard will open in your web browser.
words.not_put_back:
Setup did not finish, and could not put the old version back.

Run Setup again to install Claude Usage Monitor.
words.ended.tools_one: Setup closed the monitor's tool in a Claude Code session. If that session shows an error, type /mcp there or restart it.
words.ended.tools_other: Setup closed the monitor's tool in {EndedTools} Claude Code sessions. If one shows an error, type /mcp there or restart it.
words.ended.waits_one: A session waiting on the usage guard was let go early.
words.ended.waits_other: {EndedWaits} sessions waiting on the usage guard were let go early.
words.still_running/Uninstall:
Claude Usage Monitor is still running. It did not close when Uninstall asked it to.

Close it from its icon near the clock (right-click it, then Exit), and click Retry.
words.uninstall.taking_out: Taking Claude Usage Monitor out of Claude Code...
words.uninstall.left_default: If you set up the usage guard, its hooks and MCP tool may still be there. https://github.com/Godimas101/claude-usage-monitor/blob/main/docs/AGENT_HOOK.md says how to remove them.
words.uninstall.delete_data:
Do you also want to delete your Claude Usage Monitor settings and usage history?

This removes the settings, the usage database and the logs in:
{Folder}

Choose No to keep them, for example to reinstall later.
